entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in peak performance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I need to return something. My order number is VF-887124.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up order VF-887124. I see the Pro-Grade Cycling Shoes, delivered about 60 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. I'm just so disappointed. I really wanted them to work.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. The cycling shoes just destroy my feet. I've tried everything, moving the cleats around, different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, and I saved up for these. I really needed this money for other things if they weren't going to work out.

I completely understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, so let me see what I can do. Since you've had them for 60 days, let me just double-check the return eligibility.
Oh, I hope it's not too late. I was just trying so hard to make them work.

Not at all. I've confirmed it here. Since the cycling shoes are a standard apparel item, they fall under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, wow! Are you serious? That's such a relief. Thank you so, so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

It's my pleasure. We stand by our products. I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued.
That is wonderful news. You've really helped me out today, David. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
